actions.finding: TOCTOU race in getHandler: entry read under RLock, expiry check and delete happen unlocked
actions.description: Added a re-check under the write lock before deleting an expired entry. The delete now verifies the entry's ExpiresAt still matches the originally-read value, preventing silent data loss when setHandler writes a fresh entry between RUnlock and Lock.

summary: Addressed the review finding: fixed the TOCTOU race in getHandler by re-checking the entry under the write lock before delete.
